capabilities: Grows pixel crops from daily word count, completed checkboxes and writing streaks
Upgrades the homestead cottage across three architectural tiers
Maps top folders and most-linked hub notes to clickable cavern landmarks that open notes
Runs a 25-minute campfire focus timer with spark rewards
Exports the vault world, streak, word count and sparks as a PNG postcard
extras: Freemium: free core is fully offline with no account; Pro ($14.90 one-time or $3.99/mo, up to 3 devices) unlocks 4 extra biomes, strata III-IV, folder pinning, ambient audio and 4K postcards. Zero analytics; the only network call is a Gumroad license check. Live browser sandbox and MIT-licensed build instructions included; works on Desktop and Mobile Obsidian 1.7.2+.
problem: Obsidian offers no playful visual feedback on writing activity, so daily output, completed tasks and streaks remain abstract numbers in a text editor.

relations.evidence: Pairs with the free companion theme: VaultVale Hearthwood Theme

summary: Gamified pixel-art world that turns daily writing, tasks and streaks into crops, homestead upgrades and explorable folder strata.
